summary: Iran's military declares strategic control over the Strait of Hormuz and sets conditions for its reopening, signaling escalation in Persian Gulf tensions. Israeli forces demolished homes of two Palestinians in Beita near Nablus after accusing them of multiple explosive attacks, while artillery shelling continues across southern Lebanon. Yemen's government accuses Houthi forces of using chemical munitions on Taiz frontlines, with documented burns and mutilations prompting calls for UN investigation.
key_points: Iran's Army spokesman states the Strait of Hormuz is under strategic control and will not reopen until Iran's conditions are met. (Source: @N12chat/232335)
IDF demolishes homes of two Palestinians in Beita near Nablus, accusing them of three explosive attacks since 2024. (Source: @manniefabian/59447)
Multiple artillery shelling incidents reported across southern Lebanon including Wadi al-Hujeir, Kfar Tibnit, and Wadi al-Salouqi. (Source: @redlinkleb/50480)
Yemen's Information Minister accuses Houthis of deploying shells suspected of containing toxic chemicals on Al-Aqroud and Kahlan fronts. (Source: @shin_persian/11690)
Yemeni Armed Forces document chemical burns and mutilations on soldiers' bodies, call for UN investigation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9032)
C-130 transport aircraft lands at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran at 10:15 local time. (Source: @shin_persian/11692)
Explosions in Baharestan, Isfahan attributed to unexploded ordnance. (Source: @shin_persian/11695)
French President Macron links domestic unrest to war in Iran, Hormuz blockade, and fuel price spikes. (Source: @N12chat/232345)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's military declares strategic control over the Strait of Hormuz and refuses to reopen it until its conditions are met, directly linking the critical waterway to broader geopolitical demands. Simultaneously, Israeli forces conducted targeted home demolitions in the West Bank against alleged attackers, while intense artillery shelling continues across multiple locations in southern Lebanon. In Yemen, both the internationally recognized government and Yemeni Armed Forces accuse Houthi forces of deploying chemical munitions and mutilating bodies on the Taiz frontlines, prompting calls for international investigation.

points: A C-130 transport aircraft landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran at 10:15 local time (0645Z), indicating ongoing military air movements in the capital. (Source: @shin_persian/11692)
New explosions occurred in Baharestan, Isfahan Province, attributed to unexploded ordnance (UXO), suggesting residual contamination from previous incidents. (Source: @shin_persian/11695)

The Iranian Army spokesman stated that the enemy initially targeted Iran's nuclear and missile capabilities, then the resistance front and the regime, and now openly declares the dismemberment of Iran and destruction of its civilization. (Source: @N12chat/232335)

The spokesman asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is under the strategic control of Iran's armed forces and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are fully met, directly linking the waterway's status to broader geopolitical demands. (Source: @N12chat/232335)

French President Emmanuel Macron attributed France's purchasing power crisis to the war in Iran, the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, and resulting fuel price increases, dismissing domestic policy causes. (Source: @N12chat/232345)

The IDF launched a nationwide weapon return campaign from November 1–12, opening 65 collection points at bases for reservists to return firearms, night-vision gear, communications equipment, uniforms, protective vests, helmets, and medical equipment without identification or prosecution. (Source: @manniefabian/59446)

The campaign aims to strengthen public safety, prevent unauthorized use of military equipment, and reduce risks of weapons reaching hostile elements, according to the military. (Source: @manniefabian/59446)

Israeli forces, including combat engineers from the elite Yahalom Unit, demolished the homes of Ibrahim Daoud and Zakaria Daoud in Beita near Nablus, accusing them of carrying out three explosive device attacks in 2024 and 2025 that injured several Israeli security personnel. (Source: @manniefabian/59447)
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Hujeir and al-Qantara in southern Lebanon, as indicated by real-time mapping alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/50480)
Warplanes were observed heading south over Lebanon, suggesting ongoing aerial activity in the region. (Source: @redlinkleb/50494)
Artillery shelling struck Kfar Tibnit and al-Khardali in southern Lebanon, according to live map updates. (Source: @redlinkleb/50437)
Additional artillery shelling hit Wadi al-Salouqi in southern Lebanon, continuing the pattern of bombardment. (Source: @redlinkleb/50440)
Further shelling was recorded in Wadi Zibqin, southern Lebanon, per real-time monitoring. (Source: @redlinkleb/50489)
Artillery fire also targeted Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, adding to the multiple impact zones. (Source: @redlinkleb/50481)
